```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a bar plot for the top 10 most common dog breeds
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)

sns.set(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.values, y=top_breeds.index, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=16)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
